newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline dips on API data, UK buying suspected.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline dips on API data, UK buying suspected.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices fell slightly after a rise in U.S. gasoline inventories, but traders detected heavy buying that may be tied to stockbuilding before the U.K. budget on November 26.
A Scandanavian producer was believed to have bought Eurograde barges several times today, possibly to meet needs in Britain before the budget, traders said.
"A bullish sentiment is definitely there for the month of November," said one trader.
Eurograde 2,000 tonne barges traded at least four times at $225 fob ARA, unchanged from Tuesday, traders said.
